inclusion_criteria: Completed surgery for breast cancer with definitive histopathological analysis of the surgical specimen available.
Histological tumor size > 10 mm and ≤ 30 mm (pT1c/T2 ≤ 30 mm control group).
HER2-negative breast carcinoma defined as IHC score 0.
HER2-negative breast carcinoma defined as IHC score 1+.
HER2 IHC 2+ with negative in situ hybridization (FISH, CISH, or SISH).
Estrogen receptor (ER) negative invasive carcinoma (< 1% stained cells by immunohistochemistry).
Progesterone receptor (PR) negative invasive carcinoma (< 1% stained cells by immunohistochemistry).
In case of multifocal tumors, the largest tumor must be ≤ 10 mm according to subgroup criteria.
In case of multifocal tumors, the largest tumor must be ≤ 30 mm according to subgroup criteria.
All lesions in multifocal disease must be ER-negative.
All lesions in multifocal disease must be PR-negative.
All lesions in multifocal disease must be HER2-negative.
Clear surgical margins required in case of breast-conserving surgery.
Affiliation to a Social Health Insurance in France.
Written informed consent signed prior to any study-specific procedure.
exclusion_criteria: Previous malignancy at another site except adequately treated basal cell carcinoma.
Previous malignancy at another site except adequately treated squamous cell carcinoma.
Previous non-melanomatous skin cancer unless totally resected.
Non-invasive breast carcinoma (ductal carcinoma in situ exclusively).
Prior neoadjuvant treatment (other systemic therapy) before surgery.
Psychological condition preventing informed consent or compliance with study procedures.
Familial situation preventing informed consent or compliance with study procedures.
Geographic situation preventing informed consent or compliance with study procedures.
Social situation preventing informed consent or compliance with study procedures.
Patient deprived of freedom by administrative or legal decision.
